# What SocialUs can and can't do

*As of 2026-11-12* · Generated by socialus-web `scripts/knowledge/capabilities.ts` from the knowledge store; never hand-edited. A line says "can" only when it is live on socialus.org, checked, and passing the overnight live check. The id in brackets is the feature behind the line.

Someone without an account can:
- Type a zip to find out whether SocialUs is open where you live [F076]
- Leave an email to be told when your area opens, without an account [F076]
Can't right now:
- See which Pages near you have something on, and sign in to read it: the overnight check of the live site found a problem on the page screen; back once it passes [F093]
Can't yet:
- Sign up with your name, email and zip; the zip sets your area (built, waiting on its checks) [F081]
- Help open your town by saying whether you make things or come to find them (not built yet) [F118]

- Narrow what you see in plain words, and type the same words again later [F092]

- Get a shelf for each interest you pick, up to three [F121]
